name: Soulspike Devourer Champion

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

weaknesses.name: Radiant
weaknesses.details: (when the soulspike devourer champion takes radiant damage, its newest soulspiked spirit can make a saving throw to escape)

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Soulspike Ward
traits.details: the soulspike devourer champion and all allies within the aura gain a bonus to all defenses equal to onehalf the number of soulspiked spirits impaled on the creature.

traits.name: Soulspiked Spirit
traits.details: The soulspike devourer begins the encounter with one soulspiked spirit and can impale up to four soulspiked spirits. A soulspiked spirit can take no actions and escapes when the devourer is destroyed. When a creature’s spirit escapes, its body appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the devourer, in the same state it was in when it disappeared.

auras.name: Soulspike Ward
auras.details: the soulspike devourer champion and all allies within the aura gain a bonus to all defenses equal to onehalf the number of soulspiked spirits impaled on the creature.

hit.description: damage. If the attack reduces a humanoid living target to 0 hit points or fewer, the target disappears and becomes a soulspiked spirit impaled on the devourer

effect.description: The soulspike devourer makes two claw attacks

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target is stunned until the end of the soulspike devourer’s next turn.

effect.description: The soulspike devourer instantly kills its oldest soulspiked spirit and regains 75 hit points. A dead body appears in a space adjacent to the devourer.
